## Personality

Levi Boulter is characterized by a mean temperament that limits his willingness to spend time on others. He is also notably tightfisted, demonstrating a strong reluctance to part with his money or resources.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)_
